description.narrative: The education system further improves the quality of learning at the primary and secondary levels, based on an upgraded curriculum and the introduction of more interactive and child-centred classroom practices that support the development of both functional and transferable life skills and competencies, the inclusion of children with disabilities, the effective socialization of both girls and boys and their future adaptation to socioeconomic and climate-change risks.
